examples.english: In a village in the Illapel department, one of the members of a large family got severely ill. Soon suspicions arose that it was a curse cast by a witch in the village, and to make sure of this, they consulted a machi that lived ten or twelve leguas away.

examples.text: En una aldehuela del departamento de Illapel, enformó de gravedad uno de los individuos de una numerosa familia. Pronto surgió la sospecha de que se trataba de un maleficio, causado por una Bruja del mismo lugar, y, para cerciorarse de ello, fueron a consultar a un Machi que vivía diez o doce leguas distante de ahí.
examples.translation: In a village in the Illapel department, one of the members of a large family got severely ill. Soon suspicions arose that it was a curse cast by a witch in the village, and to make sure of this, they consulted a machi that lived ten or twelve leguas away.

examples.translation: When in the bank, make sure that cell phone calls are not made inside the finantial institution.
